title: Senior Software Engineer (Golang+Typescript)
description:
Perforce is a community of collaborative experts, problem solvers, and possibility seekers who believe work should be both challenging and fun. We are proud to inspire creativity, foster belonging, support collaboration, and encourage wellness. At Perforce, you’ll work with and learn from some of the best and brightest in business. Before you know it, you’ll be in the middle of a rewarding career at a company headed in one direction: upward.  
  
With a global footprint spanning more than 80 countries and including over 75% of the Fortune 100, Perforce Software, Inc. is trusted by the world’s leading brands to deliver solutions for the toughest challenges. The best run DevOps teams in the world choose Perforce.  

Position Summary:

We are looking for an experienced senior software engineer, who has hands-on experience with Golang and TypeScript (Angular). Your daily tasks will include feature development, technical designs, refactoring and creating proof of concept solutions for our P4 One product.

P4 One is a free desktop version control application built by Perforce specifically for artists, designers, and creators. It provides an intuitive, visual interface for managing large binary files and tracking creative assets (like 3D models and 2D textures) without requiring deep technical knowledge of complex version control systems.

All employees are expected to demonstrate AI fluency appropriate to their role and level, including responsible use of AI tools, sound judgment, and adherence to company AI governance and security policy standards.

Come work with us! Our team members are valued for their contributions, introduced to new opportunities, and rewarded well. Perforce combines the experience and rewards of a start-up with the security of an established and privately held profitable company.
 
If you are passionate about the technology that impacts our day-to-day lives and want to work with talented and dedicated people across the globe, apply today!
 
www.perforce.com

Responsibilities:
•    Write application code for P4 One backend as well as front end. 
•    Do detailed code reviews for other developers in your agile team
•    Write unit and integration tests for the code changes
•    Analyse performance and security of the components you are working with and provide input for improvements
•    Work with rest of the Development team to break down business requirements into technical tasks
•    Refactor old codebase
•    Create Proof of Concept solutions for new technologies and features
•    Mentor and technically guide other engineers on the team, as needed.
Requirements:

•    You have 8+ years of professional experience as a software engineer, ideally with complex systems, and Enterprise applications
•    BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent
Mandatory:
•    Comfortable working autonomously and making end-user focused product decisions
•    Languages: Golang, TypeScript (Angular)
•    Experience with CI/CD processes and P4 version control
Nice to have:
•    Experience in the VFX, Animation, or Games industry
•    Experience with Docker
•    Experience with AI driven software development
